name: Zhangzhou

queries.query: Zhangzhou official cadastral parcel map land registry GIS service Fujian natural resources bureau
queries.scope: Find official city land registry/cadastral sources and inspect anonymous map or parcel geometry routes.
queries.result: Zhangzhou has an official municipal natural-resources bureau and real-property registration services. The publicly documented “Land Supermarket” is a limited marketplace for a first batch of 208 marketed land parcels with map location, not an all-parcels cadastral viewer. The city “One Map” system serves planning and resource-management workflows. The official bureau and Fujian registration application sites were not readable through the public page reader, and no anonymous parcel geometry route/schema was found. No parcel geometry was retained.
queries.executionMethod: Separate English/local-language search followed by first-party official page review and bounded anonymous service-route inspection where available.

queries.query: 漳州 不动产登记 网上办事大厅 地籍图公众查询 官方 土地超市 地图
queries.scope: Find official city land registry/cadastral sources and inspect anonymous map or parcel geometry routes.
queries.result: Official sources describe Zhangzhou Land Supermarket as a WeChat mini-program marketplace for selected marketed low-efficiency land, not as a cadastral registry layer. The April 2025 launch listed 208 parcels; a November 2025 official follow-up reported 350 listed and 19 transacted, showing that the count is time-dependent. Published descriptions and the public screenshot show map browsing/location and listing cards, but no parcel-boundary geometry, safe native parcel-ID field, or anonymous vector schema was verified. An ordinary anonymous GET to the linked municipal bureau host timed out. No parcel geometry was retained.

pointBasis: UN WUP 2025 population-weighted settlement centroid; this is not a municipal boundary or a parcel-coverage claim.
registryBasis: The official provincial natural-resources report directly names Zhangzhou’s Real Estate Registration Center and its local registration work, including rights registration in the city’s Xiangcheng and Longwen districts. This city-specific evidence establishes registration activity; Land Supermarket offers and planning data do not establish public cadastral geometry.
